principles: Preliminary delivery date is a planning anchor, not an automatic commitment.
A past preliminary delivery date triggers milestone review; it does not imply actual delivery.
Recommended deadlines are advisory until a human approves the contract.
Once a v2.9.2 contract is activated, its frozen deadline/baseline/outcome design must not be rewritten.

schedule_bands.reason: The preliminary date has passed; confirm actual delivery/status before using delivery timing to authorize a new experiment.
Too close to preliminary delivery for a new long experiment; prioritize closeout, reconciliation, or very short measured actions.
Limited runway before preliminary delivery; decisions should be narrow, measurable, and fast.
Enough runway for a controlled intervention with a medium evaluation window.
Long runway permits disciplined experimentation and stronger outcome measurement.

ACTIVATION_CANDIDATE.description: Deadline for human approval/readiness, not the building delivery date.

DESIGN_ONLY.description: Deadline to finish Value to Capture/intervention design; not permission to execute.

BLOCKED_RECONCILIATION.description: Deadline to reconcile economics/data before any activation can be considered.

EVIDENCE_BUILDING.description: Deadline for the next evidence/readiness review; not an execution deadline.
